evidence_scope: Source-grounded documentary Resolution references, CR target TS38.133 and final-register affirmative document outcomes. Complete native635 and selected10 match immutable SQL. All28 cutoff candidates are source-certified; any distinct10 of18 highest Resolution-ID pairs is accepted.
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'}) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId DESC LIMIT 10
question_en: List the resolutions and the approved CRs that modify spec 38.133 (decision-to-change trace).
reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'}) WHERE toLower(trim(coalesce(cr.status, ''))) IN ['agreed', 'approved', 'endorsed'] RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId DESC LIMIT 10
